Added support for installing packages from named npm registries (like GitHub Packages) via a short prefix syntax (e.g. `gh:@acme/foo`).

### `resolving/npm-resolver/src/parseBareSpecifier.ts`
- **`BUILTIN_NAMED_REGISTRIES`** — frozen record mapping `gh` → `https://npm.pkg.github.com/`.
- **`NamedRegistryPackageSpec`** — extends `RegistryPackageSpec` with `registryName`.
- **`parseNamedRegistrySpecifierToRegistryPackageSpec(...)`** — parses `<alias>:<body>`; returns `null` for unknown aliases (npm:/jsr:/catalog:/workspace:/github:) or when a bare version selector has no `packageAlias`; throws `ERR_PNPM_INVALID_NAMED_REGISTRY_PACKAGE_NAME` (message includes e.g. `'work:'`) for scope-only names; keeps package names as-is (no scope rewriting).
- **`parseBareSpecifier`** — `npm:<semver-range>` + alias now uses the alias as the package name.

### `installing/deps-resolver/src/replaceVersionInBareSpecifier.ts`
- Added optional `namedRegistryPrefixes` param (default `[]`). Handles `gh:^1.0.0`→`gh:1.1.0`, `gh:@acme/foo@^1.0.0`→`gh:@acme/foo@1.1.0`, `gh:@acme/foo`→`gh:@acme/foo@1.1.0`; leaves other schemes unchanged.

### `resolving/npm-resolver/src/index.ts`
- **`NamedRegistryResolveResult`** interface; `NpmResolver` union widened.
- **`createNpmResolver`** — accepts `namedRegistries` (user entries override built-ins), validates each URL is http/https (throws `ERR_PNPM_INVALID_NAMED_REGISTRY_URL` synchronously otherwise), and returns **`resolveFromNamedRegistry`**.
- **`resolveFromNamedRegistry`** — resolves against the matched named registry, uses `getAuthHeader` with the named-registry URL, caches under `ABBREVIATED_META_DIR` keyed by registry hostname + package name (via `pickPackage`), and computes `normalizedBareSpecifier` (`<alias>:<range>` or `<alias>:<pkgName>@<range>`).

### `config/reader/src/getOptionsFromRootManifest.ts` + `core/types` (`PnpmSettings`)
- Added `namedRegistries?: Record<string, string>` to `PnpmSettings`, and env-var expansion (`${VAR}`) of the URL string values inside both `registries` and `namedRegistries`.

### `resolving/default-resolver/src/index.ts`
- Wired `resolveFromNamedRegistry` into the resolver chain so the feature works end-to-end.
